description: List the voices available to speak with: the ready-made library voices plus every voice this account has cloned or designed. Each one comes back with its voice_id (pass that to the speaking tools), its name, whether it is ready-made or one of your own, labels saying who it sounds like (gender, age, accent, what it suits) and a preview_url that plays a short sample. Optional search matches a name or a description, for example "warm female narrator" or "deep british male". Set mine_only true to see only the voices you made yourself. count defaults to 30 (max 100). Free and read only.

count.description: How many voices to list. Default 30, max 100.

mine_only.description: Optional. true shows only the voices you cloned or designed yourself.

search.description: Optional. Words to match in the name or the description, e.g. "calm female documentary".

name: list_voices
title: List Voices
